description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the PurgeDao component within the OrangeHRM Maintenance Plugin. It tests employee data purging functionalities such as checking if an employee is purgeable and extracting employee data based on employee numbers.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing PurgeDao methods related to employee data purging.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating PurgeDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testIsEmployeePurgeable
methods.description: Asserts whether employees with specific IDs are purgeable or not.

methods.name: testExtractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Verifies extraction of employee data by employee number and related tables.
